# Functions {.inverse}

## Example Dataset

```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)

diabetes_dat <- read_csv("../data/diabetes_uci/diabetes_data.csv") %>%
  clean_names()

glimpse(diabetes_dat)
```

## Check Relationship Between Diabetes and High BP

```{r}
chisq.test(diabetes_dat$diabetes_binary, diabetes_dat$high_bp)
```

## ... Between Diabetes and Smoking

```{r}
chisq.test(diabetes_dat$diabetes_binary, diabetes_dat$smoker)
```
